summary: Supply-chain pinning (ADR-0055, TM-16). In ci.yml, live-memory.yml and security.yml every third-party action moves from its major tag to the commit SHA of the current release (checkout v7.0.1, setup-python v7.1.0, setup-go v7.0.0, upload-artifact v7.0.2; each SHA equals the current v7 tag, so behaviour is unchanged); threat-model.yml, threat-review.yml and trusted-security-gate.yml were already pinned and are untouched. govulncheck goes from @latest to v1.9.0 and pip-audit to ==2.10.1. pip-audit now also audits router/requirements-session.txt, requirements-dev.txt, test/requirements-hindsight.txt and rerank-server/requirements.txt (all clean locally); decision-jevlike stays out because it installs a git dependency and an unpinned transformers stack (noted). monitoring/compose.yaml pins prom/prometheus:v3.15.1 and grafana/grafana:13.3.0 to their multi-arch index digests, verified equal to the RepoDigests of the containers running in the reference deployment, so a redeploy changes nothing. The decision-service Dockerfiles pin python:3.11-slim to its index digest. Dependabot gains docker-compose (/monitoring) and docker (decision services). test/check_pinned_references.py enforces the rule in CI (workflow actions, go install, pip tools, compose images, Dockerfile FROM) with a self-test of rejected and accepted forms. Permissions, triggers, secrets and job logic are unchanged; the ADR-0050 Dependabot exemption parser accepts the SHA-plus-version-comment form, so future action bumps keep that path. Workflow and review-policy changes should still be looked at by the maintainer.

findings.evidence: Before: 23 movable references (actions by tag in three workflows, govulncheck@latest, unversioned pip-audit, two compose images and two base images by tag); pip-audit covered only router/requirements.txt.
findings.resolution: Pinned and enforced in CI; optional requirement sets audited. Hash-locked Python installs and release provenance remain open, so TM-16 stays open in the register.

tests.evidence: 0 failure(s) over 19 rejected/accepted cases; Pinned references: 0 finding(s).

tests.command: Negative check: python test/check_pinned_references.py on the unchanged tree (git stash)
tests.evidence: Pinned references: 23 finding(s), e.g. 'monitoring/compose.yaml:35: image grafana/grafana:13.3.0 has no @sha256 digest'.

tests.command: python -m pip_audit -r <file> (pip-audit 2.10.1) for router/requirements-session.txt, requirements-dev.txt, test/requirements-hindsight.txt, rerank-server/requirements.txt
Image digests: Docker Hub index digest lookup and docker image inspect RepoDigests of the running monitoring containers
tests.evidence: prometheus sha256:fa330227...191a2 and grafana sha256:488984b7...0b205 match the running containers.

tests.command: gh api repos/<action>/commits/<tag> for the four actions
tests.evidence: Release SHAs equal the current v7 major tags (checkout 3d3c42e5, setup-python 6d4fd22b, setup-go b7ad1dad, upload-artifact cf430e03).

tests.command: ruff check .; check_adr_index.py; YAML parse of all workflows, dependabot.yml and monitoring/compose.yaml; selftest_threat_review.py; selftest_trusted_gate.py
tests.evidence: All checks passed; ADR index ok: 55 ADRs; yaml ok; both self-tests exit 0.

limitations: The new pip-audit loop and the docker/docker-compose Dependabot ecosystems are first exercised in CI and on GitHub.
The decision-service images were not rebuilt with the pinned base image.
decision-jevlike requirements are not audited (git dependency, unpinned transformers stack); hash-locked Python installs and release provenance remain open.
